import random
print(random.randint(1, 10)) # 1 to 10, both included
print(random.random()) # 0.0 to 1.0
print(random.choice(["apple", "mango"])) # random item
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
random.shuffle(nums) # shuffles in place
print(nums)
Note: randint(a, b) includes both ends, unlike range(a, b).
